en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya,f rom Humran Bin Ayn who said,

‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is the place of the scholars<sup>asws</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Similar to Zil Qarnayn, and companion of Suleyman<sup>as</sup> and companion of Musa<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Humran ibn A‘yan who has said that he asked abu Ja‘far (a.s.) the following.

“What is the position of the scholars?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “ It is like Dhul Qarnayn, (see 18:83 – 99 Holy Quran),the companion of Solomon (see 27:40),and the companion of Moses (a.s.) (See 18:65)”
